lede: Seventeen feeds, and not one topic crossed between them this Sunday, October 11. The pulse reads 15 out of 100, a genuinely fragmented day where attention pooled narrowly rather than gathering anywhere. On GitHub, a newcomer called morluto/rea topped the trending list by collecting close to 26,000 stars in a single day, and over on Wikipedia the most-read page was, of all things, Mathematics at 420,000 views.

throughlines.title: Mathematics
throughlines.gist: The most-read article on Wikipedia today at 420,000 views, edging out a companion List of equations page sitting just behind it.

throughlines.title: morluto/rea
throughlines.gist: A repository that topped GitHub's trending board by gathering roughly 25,800 stars in a single day, the fastest climb on the list.

throughlines.title: WallHop – 12ft.io is gone, so I built a replacement
throughlines.gist: A developer's homegrown replacement for the now-defunct 12ft.io paywall skipper, leading Hacker News with 191 points and 85 comments.
